subject: Data Engineering
title: Choosing Your Pipeline Pattern
description: A micro-lesson that makes Choosing Your Pipeline Pattern usable.

hook.text: Batch, streaming, micro-batch, event-driven — with so many patterns, how do you choose?

buildup.text: Start with the business question: how fresh does the data need to be for the consumer?

discovery.text: Match the pattern to the SLA. Daily reports need batch. Fraud alerts need streaming.

twist.text: Most teams over-engineer by choosing streaming when hourly micro-batch would suffice.

climax.text: The best pipeline is the simplest one that meets the freshness, cost, and reliability requirements.

punchline.text: Complexity is a cost. Choose the simplest pattern that works.

quiz.question: What should primarily guide the choice of pipeline pattern?
options: The data freshness requirement of the consumer
The size of the engineering team
